body.text: How much time does IST Fast Track save at passport control and security?

During peak international arrival and departure waves (05:00–09:00, 13:00–16:00, and 21:00–01:00), iGA Fast Track lanes typically save 25 to 50 minutes over standard queues. On departure, priority access covers terminal entrance screening at Gates 1, 3, or 7 plus international passport and security checkpoints.

According to [Istanbul Airport's official passenger guide](https://www.istairport.com/ucuslar/havalimani-rehberleri/giden-yolcu-rehberi), [iGA Fast Track](https://www.igapass.com/en/iga-fast-track-p-4000?locale=en) lanes operate at terminal entry doors 1, 3, and 7, international passport control, domestic second security, and international transfer checkpoints. Turkish Airlines Business Class passengers use Entrance Gate 5, while travellers aged 65 and over receive complimentary iGA Fast Track access at designated security and passport lanes.
How do IGA Lounge, Turkish Airlines Business Lounge and private CIP terminals compare?

Your best lounge choice at IST depends on your airline ticket, loyalty tier, and privacy requirements. The paid iGA Lounge is open to any international passenger regardless of airline or cabin, Turkish Airlines lounges serve Star Alliance Business and elite flyers, and the standalone General Aviation / VIP terminal serves private charters and diplomatic delegations.

The [iGA Lounge](https://www.igapass.com/en/iga-lounge-p-6000?locale=en) runs 24/7 with hot buffet dining, showers, quiet workspaces, and terrace seating. By contrast, [Turkish Airlines International Lounges](https://www.turkishairlines.com/en-us/flights/fly-different/international-lounge/) (Lounge Business and Lounge Miles&Smiles) offer live chef stations and private suites for qualifying long-haul transit passengers. For full tarmac-to-curb privacy, [iGA Meet & Greet](https://www.igapass.com/en/iga-meet-and-greet-p-7000?locale=en) bundles Fast Track, iGA Lounge, private buggy, and a personal escort starting at €207.50 + VAT per adult.

body.text: When is buggy service worth booking inside IST's massive terminal?

Buggy service is worth booking whenever you land at far concourses (such as outer A, B, or F gates), carry heavy hand luggage, face a tight connection, or travel with elderly companions or medical recovery needs. Inside [iGA Istanbul Airport's 1.4-million-square-meter terminal](https://www.istairport.com/en/corporate/about-us?locale=en), walking from a remote gate to passport control can easily exceed 15 to 20 minutes.

Per [Istanbul Airport's transfer and departure guides](https://www.istairport.com/ucuslar/havalimani-rehberleri/transfer-yolcu-rehberi), electric iGA Buggy stops operate airside after international passport control opposite Gates C1, D1, and E1, and on arrivals near Gates A3–A5, B5–B7, D9, and F5–F6. Guests aged 65+, parents with infants (0–2 years), and iGA Pass holders use shared buggy routes free of charge, while private point-to-point buggies are included in iGA Meet & Greet.

body.text: How does ITO coordinate meet-and-greet directly from the gate to your vehicle?

Itinerary of Türkiye aligns your official airport Meet & Greet booking with your external private chauffeur so there is no gap between exiting customs and stepping into your car. Because external drivers cannot enter airside zones, timing the handover between the airport greeter and curbside pickup prevents confusing waits in crowded arrival halls.

As an independent, client-paid, flat-fee advisory ([Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about))—paid by our clients and independent of provider commissions—we verify your flight number, advise whether standalone Fast Track or full iGA Meet & Greet fits your actual arrival wave, and share live flight-tracking updates with your licensed transfer driver. Your airport greeter escorts you from the jet bridge through Fast Track passport control and baggage claim directly to the designated arrival gate where your vehicle is waiting.

faq.q: How much does iGA Meet & Greet cost at Istanbul Airport in 2026?
faq.a: According to iGA Pass, standard adult iGA Meet & Greet starts at €207.50 plus VAT per person, bundling a personal assistant, iGA Fast Track, iGA Lounge access, and private buggy service inside the terminal.

faq.q: Can I buy Istanbul Airport Fast Track if I am flying Economy Class?
faq.a: Yes. Any passenger flying any airline or cabin class can purchase iGA Fast Track online via iGA Pass or at airport kiosks before security and passport control.

faq.q: Are iGA Fast Track and iGA Buggy free for seniors over 65?
faq.a: Yes. Istanbul Airport's age-friendly policy grants passengers aged 65 and older complimentary access to iGA Fast Track lanes at designated checkpoints and free use of shared iGA Buggy routes.

faq.q: Does iGA Lounge accept Priority Pass or only paid bookings?
faq.a: The international iGA Lounge accepts direct paid bookings and participating programs such as Priority Pass, subject to stay limits and capacity.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book wheelchair assistance versus an iGA Buggy?
faq.a: Request airline wheelchair assistance at least 48 hours before departure. Book private iGA Meet & Greet with a dedicated buggy 24 to 48 hours ahead during peak waves.

faq.q: Can a private driver meet me at the aircraft gate at Istanbul Airport?
faq.a: No. Only authorized airport staff such as iGA Meet & Greet assistants can enter airside gate and passport areas. Your assistant escorts you through customs to the landside arrival gate where your pre-arranged vehicle waits.
